tips.text: Have 500 Ducats banked before Baro lands; Prisma weapons follow no fixed schedule.
Sell your duplicate Prime parts first, then crack relics for the gold parts.
Crack relics in a full squad of four and take the highest-Ducat part.
Buy it the first time it appears; players who skipped it regretted it when the Incarnon arrived.
The Ducats are the easy part; waiting for Baro to restock it is the painful part.
